messages.author: c69c89eff5f12d04
messages.subject: readModel from simulation result
parts:
Hi group,

I'm conducting a simulation study.
I'd like to get a table of simulation result (population, average, population_sd, averate_se, mse, cover_95, pct_sig_coef) from a directory.

so I tried using readModel as like below,

>allModelParameters <-readModels("C:/Users/skson/Documents/R_Mplus_practice/study1", recursive=TRUE, filefilter ="s1_c*.*", what="parameters")

however, when I used SummaryTable, I got error message.
> SummaryTable(allModelParameters, keepCols=c("Title","population", "average", "population_sd"))

Error in subsetModelList(modelList, keepCols, dropCols, sortBy) : 
  All fields passed as keepCols are missing from data.frame
  Fields in data.frame are:

How can I get the simulation result?
Simulation input files successfully worked using runModels. Is there the problem in readModels syntax or SummaryTable? 


Best regards,
Sookyoung.

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: readModel from simulation result
parts:
Hi Sookyoung,

SummaryTable is intended to show the summary (global) statistics of multiple models. These are in the $summaries element from readModels(). Example include AIC, LL, and number of parameters.

It sounds like you're interested in the parameter-level statistics Mplus generates from the simulation. These would be in $parameters element of the output from readModels. When in doubt, use the str() command to get a sense of the structure of the output of readModels.

So, I think you'd want something like:

lapply(allModelParameters, function(model) {
  print(model$parameters$unstandardized)
})

Or you could add the model name as a column within the anonymous function and use do.call(rbind, ...) to combine these into one data.frame.

Hope this helps,
Michael
